_comment: Viewer settings. Layers come from the GLB (extras.layer = Blender collection); this file only gives display names, order, default visibility and the Linked LiDAR colour. Unknown layers still appear under their own name (grey in Linked LiDAR). Design files site-model/exports/design_<name>.glb load on top of the model (listed in assets/models.json); their layers default to the Design style, visible, also over the point cloud. Camera values are three.js coordinates: x = east, y = up (m, NAVD88), z = -north, from the site origin E 384580 / N 3768520.

linked._comment: Point cloud, Color = Layer: points coloured by the layer colours below, from the Coolors trending palette F0EAD2 · DDE5B6 · ADC178 · A98467 · 6C584C (Other darkened from Terrain). The clicked object turns the highlight colour unless its layer has "highlight": false (Terrain: too large to light up).

_modes: mesh = the model; cloud = the LiDAR point cloud (old names: linked = cloud by layer, lidar = cloud by height). cloudColor = the first colouring: layer / height / class / intensity
